milestones.outcome: Every admitted macOS CLI operation acquires one exact selected-account transient credential, validates its identity with the same bytes, and uses it throughout API, publication and network Git work without retaining a durable copy.
exit_criteria: A dedicated bounded sensitive-result and sensitive-child-environment path keeps acquired bytes out of generic request/environment/output records; every owned buffer is cleared after descendants and queued work have relinquished it, including refusal, cancellation, exception, timeout, reap failure and shutdown.

Closed auth token --hostname HOST --user LOGIN runs under existing write denial and a token-free private configuration/environment, after required local capability checks; missing/unpinned/malformed/oversized/inaccessible/unsupported results refuse before API or network Git launch without another authority.

One credential scope covers connection validation, complete paginated/provider or discovery reads, each complete review/inline operation, each explicit tour run/resume, each exact-blob batch/fallback and clone/helper acquisition; each subsequent operation reacquires. No credential resides in a session/profile, core/application projection, publication grant or cross-operation cache.

The selected login and existing numeric identity validate before private content or any write, using those same bytes. Fixture global switches before acquisition, after validation and during helper work cannot change attribution; removal before acquisition produces zero API/network Git launches, mislabelled credentials produce zero writes, removal after acquisition cannot replace in-flight bytes.

Focused composed read/publication/clone/blob courses and synthetic canary lifetime/persistence negatives pass; native HTTPS/defaults, platform eligibility, exact host/PR/head/content admission, recovery and no-second-POST behavior remain valid.

Token-variable selection follows verified stock-gh hostname classification, including github.localhost and ghe.com classes, or refuses before dispatch; API and helper negative controls cannot fall back to a usable stored credential.

Failed Connect and remembered startup never use ambient auth-status network checks as an automatic credential fallback; cancellation after a durable write witness retains the same credential through GET-only reconciliation and issues no second POST.
milestones.boundary: Implements strict RFC AC01/02/03 and relevant AC05; official-gh native AC04 and full strict closeout remain unsatisfied. The existing CLI publication warning remains until the strict qualification milestone is accepted.

milestones.outcome: The strict credential RFC has direct supported-macOS stock-gh evidence and all five criteria are reconciled against the exact candidate before popup work starts.
exit_criteria: Official gh on supported macOS proves exact named lookup failure despite a usable unnamed synthetic credential, selected-account API use, inherited credential through the gh-owned HTTPS Git/helper path, and unchanged global active state/configuration. Local negatives use disposable synthetic credentials; live reads/publications target only MikeMarcin/BPR-Test and record rate response headers without tokens.

All strict AC01–AC05 have direct criterion/revision/evidence records. Required independent critical implementation acceptance is supplied or stays pending; fixture success and help/version admission are not substituted for native behavior.

Narrow live token-rule amendments, architecture enforcement, operator/security/host descriptions and no-persistence/memory limits match the candidate; historical tokenless plans/evidence and BPR-1373 pending owner judgment remain intact.

The final strict candidate passes focused admission, identity, cancellation, recovery, architecture, format/tidy and documentation checks; task commands/descendants are quiescent and evidence accurately bounds tool/platform/native qualification.
milestones.boundary: Full first RFC acceptance. Second RFC depends on this actual qualified capability/evidence; no platform expansion, direct production Keychain reader, fork, global account mutation or token persistence.

milestones.outcome: Qualified CLI review, inline and tour publication use their ordinary deliberate gestures with exact one-use admission and truthful actionable failure/connection text.
exit_criteria: Comment, Approve, Request changes, inline Publish and explicit immutable-plan tour publication do not open a CLI-specific modal; exact target, actor, disposition/content and one-use operation grants remain checked immediately at issuance and provider dispatch.

Runtime strict capability is required and every operation reacquires before dispatch; unsupported or failed acquisition refuses instead of restoring the old popup or creating a warning bypass. Trust/discovery/startup reuse issue zero writes.

Typed missing/unavailable/denied/tool/indeterminate outcomes reach existing review, comment and tour surfaces, preserve drafts and unknown-result reconciliation, and expose no raw process/Keychain details. Resolve stock-gh missing-vs-denied observability honestly before claiming the companion distinction.

First-use connection question and Accounts & hosts disclose chosen account/server, existing gh sign-in, remembered reuse, transient token and no BPR persistence. Residual executable/certificate/redirect/helper trust remains in the existing disclosure; stale tokenless/ambient-switch/socket claims are removed.
frontend-design is loaded before UX work; native palette/font/style/controls, keyboard focus and deduplicated status accessibility are preserved, with focused composed and Qt/offscreen evidence.
milestones.boundary: Companion runtime/text implementation; all its final AC01–AC05 judgments, required critical review and any required owner look remain for qualification. Native/default/read-only/local Review Cycles authority is unchanged.

milestones.outcome: The ordered pack is accepted on the exact combined candidate, with every companion criterion proven and any required owner judgment completed through a fresh short attended session.
exit_criteria: Every companion AC01–AC05 has composed macOS evidence for ordinary gestures, changed account/head/target/content refusal, strict failure draft retention, unknown attempted-write reconciliation, disclosure text and focus/status mechanics.

Required independent critical implementation review of the exact candidate is consumed with evidence-backed finding dispositions; neither implementer self-review nor tracker status substitutes for it.

Offscreen full public composition and focus/accessibility checks cover final native surfaces. If owner visual judgment is necessary, finish unattended/live work first, prepare one Accept/Reject question per criterion in a fresh short attended session, and freeze source/build inside its root with the freeze script and launcher check; no verdict is inferred.

Final baseline diff, RFC/index/card/verification/upkeep records and documentation gate agree with actual acceptance; every task-owned command is stopped except an explicitly handed-off review server, and global gh state, unrelated work and historical pending criteria remain intact.
milestones.boundary: Full selected pack closeout. Pending required native, independent or human acceptance stays open; no release/publication/push or installed-app replacement is implied.
